phases.name: Strengthen Fabric capability coverage
changes: Add a hard gate proving every required field-pack input is read by the graph or explicitly declared guard-only.
Add negative fixtures where a declared required input is present but semantically unused.
Keep the v1 package and receipts immutable; a changed gate triggers revalidation rather than retroactive rewriting.
acceptance: The current selected v0.1 definition fails the new required-input-usage gate with REQUIRED_INPUT_UNUSED.

phases.name: Version bounded surface routing
changes: Introduce a versioned verification-route token registry that binds each token to an Evidence Desk claim kind, native proof surface, and optional Verification Spine category/claim ID.
Add a bounded stable list-to-route lookup primitive under a new runtime version, or an equivalently closed field-pack representation that can use every affected surface without unbounded iteration.
Version the Software & Workshop field pack and bind the new runtime, pack, registry, and metric digests.
acceptance: Unknown surface and route tokens are refused.
Different semantically relevant surface sets produce appropriately different route tokens.

phases.name: Generate and compare a v0.2 challenger
changes: Regenerate lean, balanced, and guarded challengers from the repaired pack.
Add held-out and metamorphic cases for runtime-only, Hub/mobile, archive/persistence, and passive receiver transport surfaces.
Compare the challenger against the preserved v0.1 receipt without auto-superseding it.
acceptance: All hard gates pass, surface sensitivity is proven, ties remain visible, and package rebuild parity holds.

phases.name: Add a trusted read-only planning adapter
changes: Expose a pure plan action accepting an explicit typed change brief and exact verified definition lineage.
Return a typed verification route plan plus an optional Evidence Desk prefill packet.
Never run tests, operate a browser, write state, stage, install, merge, promote, or change CANON.
acceptance: Allowed and denied host calls are tested.
Every emitted token resolves through the exact registry.
Candidate organ.js is never required or executed by the adapter.

phases.name: Repeat Nursery and human selection
changes: Scan the v0.2 package through Nursery and repeat independent behavior, authority, and integration proofs.
Ask Mike to retain, reject, or select the challenger; record supersession only after explicit choice.
acceptance: Mike remains the implementation and merge gate.
Status remains EXPERIMENTAL until explicitly changed.
